description: Cases every implementation of nemar.sensor-labels.v1 reproduces. Each case lists a recording's channels as [name, BIDS type or null] in recording order, its sidecar's cap_model and eeg_reference (BIDS CapManufacturersModelName and EEGReference, each null when absent), and the result: the outcome, the refusal reason, the montage, the counts, the contending montages, the duplicated electrodes, the reference channel (reported, not dropped: a map leaves it out only when all its values are exactly zero), and per channel its status, its normalized key and the montage electrode it is placed on. The montages are views/montages with the SHA-256 digests listed here.

cases.name: ten_twenty
cases.description: The 19 electrodes of the 10-20 system, with modern names.

cases.name: ten_twenty_legacy_names
cases.description: T3, T4, T5 and T6 are the ACNS aliases of T7, T8, P7 and P8.

cases.name: legacy_and_modern_name_together
cases.description: T3 and T7 name one electrode, so two channels map to it.

cases.name: edf_prefix_and_reference
cases.description: European Data Format (EDF) style names with an EEG prefix and a reference suffix; a typed ECG channel and an untyped photic channel are excluded and not counted.

cases.name: eeg_prefix_variants
cases.description: Each separator after the EEG prefix is stripped; EEG directly followed by a letter or a digit is not a prefix.

cases.name: nihon_kohden_pol_prefix
cases.description: Nihon Kohden names carry POL and a space, in any case; POL directly followed by a letter is not a prefix.

cases.name: channel_types
cases.description: Types are trimmed of the step-2 whitespace and folded A to Z, without NFKC: empty and N/A are untyped, ' EEG ' and eeg are EEG, and U+FEFF before EEG, U+0085 after it, or full-width letters make another type.

cases.name: names_with_other_line_breaks
cases.description: U+0085, U+2028 and U+FEFF are not whitespace here: names carrying them keep them and match nothing.

cases.name: unicode_hyphen_is_not_a_split
cases.description: Fp1-REF written with U+2010 (hyphen), not U+002D: no split, so the name matches nothing.

cases.name: trailing_dots_untyped
cases.description: Untyped names padded with dots to four characters.

cases.name: quotes_whitespace_unicode
cases.description: Quotation marks, surrounding whitespace, a no-break space and full-width characters normalize to the plain name; a space inside a name stays, so P 4 matches nothing.

cases.name: neuroscan_auxiliary_names
cases.description: A Neuroscan Quik-Cap 64, untyped, with its HEO and VEO eye channels and its cerebellar CB1 and CB2, which no montage places: their names exclude them, so they are not counted.

cases.name: clinical_auxiliary_names
cases.description: A clinical EDF export (the TUH EEG corpus's names), untyped: the 10-20 electrodes and A1 and A2 with -REF, the eye channels ROC, LOC, LUC and RLC, an EKG, the photic stimulus and the burst suppression trends IBI, BURSTS and SUPPR. The auxiliary names are excluded, so 21 of 21 candidates match; counted, they would hold the share to 21 of 28.

cases.name: unicode_newer_than_some_runtimes
cases.description: Characters whose Unicode normalization (NFKC) to ASCII depends on the Unicode version a runtime ships: OZ in outlined letters (U+1CCE4 U+1CCEF, Unicode 16), AF and an outlined 7 (U+1CCF7), Fp and the subscript z of Unicode 18 (U+209F), and the modifier capital C (U+A7F2, Unicode 14) before P1. The fold table maps none of them, so every runtime leaves the four unmatched.

cases.name: unicode_compatibility_characters
cases.description: Compatibility characters NFKC folds to ASCII in every runtime, but the fold table does not: a subscript two (F₂), a Roman numeral one hundred (U+216D) before 1, bold mathematical P, O and z (U+1D40F U+1D428 U+1D433), and a superscript four (AF⁴). They stay unmatched; full-width letters and digits still fold (C3 in full width is a duplicate of C3 and is not used here).

cases.name: common_reference_suffix
cases.description: Every name but the reference's carries -Cz: the shared suffix is the recording's reference and is stripped.

cases.name: common_reference_at_ninety_percent
cases.description: Nine of ten hyphenated names end in -Cz (90%): Cz is the reference, and the tenth, O1-F7, is a bipolar pair.

cases.name: common_reference_below_ninety_percent
cases.description: Eight of ten hyphenated names end in -Cz (80%): no common reference, so every hyphenated name is a bipolar pair.

cases.name: common_reference_on_most_names
cases.description: Ten of 19 names end in -Cz: hyphenated names are most of the names, so -Cz is the reference.

cases.name: common_reference_on_half_the_names
cases.description: Nine of 18 names end in -Cz: hyphenated names are not most of the names, so they are bipolar pairs.

cases.name: reference_names
cases.description: Each reference name after the last hyphen is stripped; a name with two hyphens splits at the last, so Fpz-Fz-Ref keeps fpz-fz and matches nothing.

cases.name: single_bipolar_among_unipolar
cases.description: One hyphenated name among unipolar ones is a bipolar pair, not a reference scheme: it stays unplaced and the rest are placed.

cases.name: bipolar_double_banana
cases.description: A clinical bipolar montage: every name is a pair of electrodes.

cases.name: numeric_labels
cases.description: Numbered channels name no electrode.

cases.name: share_too_low
cases.description: 12 of 16 names match (75%).

cases.name: share_at_threshold
cases.description: 12 of 15 names match (80%, the threshold).

cases.name: too_few_channels
cases.description: Seven candidate channels.

cases.name: too_few_matched
cases.description: Seven of eight names match: the share passes, the count does not.

cases.name: eight_matched
cases.description: Eight names, all matched (the minimum).

cases.name: excluded_channels_not_counted
cases.description: Typed non-EEG channels and untyped names with a non-EEG prefix are excluded and not counted; an EEG-typed name with such a prefix is a candidate.

cases.name: fiducials_dropped
cases.description: Fiducial names are not electrodes and are not counted.

cases.name: fiducial_names_of_egi_and_eeglab
cases.description: EGI's and EEGLAB's names for the nasion and the preauricular points (FidNz, FidT9, FidT10, Nasion, LeftEar, RightEar) are fiducials too.

cases.name: vref_outside_egi_nets
cases.description: VREF is Cz only on an EGI net, so on the 10-05 montage it stays unplaced.

cases.name: egi_129
cases.description: An EGI 128-channel net with its vertex reference (E1 to E128 and Cz), on a cap named HydroCel GSN 128 1.0 (the sensor layout name an MFF recording carries). The 257 net holds the same names, but the 129 net, of the same family and smaller, holds every name the 257 net matched.

cases.name: egi_129_zeros_and_vref
cases.description: Zero-padded numbers and VREF for the vertex reference, on a cap named by its montage name, GSN-HydroCel-129.

cases.name: egi_128
cases.description: E1 to E128 on a HydroCel GSN 128 1.0: the 129, 256 and 257 nets hold every name the 128 net matched and are larger nets of its family, so they do not contend.

cases.name: egi_e129
cases.description: E1 to E129, as many EGI exports name a 129-channel net: E129 is Cz on the 129 net. The 256 and 257 nets hold E129 as an electrode of their own, but the 129 net, of the same family and smaller, matches every channel they match. The cap model, Hydrocel Geodesic Sensor Net (as OpenNeuro ds004444 writes it), names no size, so it fits every HydroCel net.

cases.name: egi_e129_and_cz
cases.description: E129 and Cz are one electrode on the 129 net.

cases.name: egi_duplicate_after_zeros
cases.description: E001 and E1 are one electrode.

cases.name: egi_257
cases.description: A 256-channel net with its vertex reference, on a HydroCel GSN 256 1.0.

cases.name: egi_256
cases.description: E1 to E256 on a HydroCel GSN 256 1.0: the 257 net holds no name the 256 net lacks.

cases.name: egi_65
cases.description: The 64-channel net, version 1.0, with its vertex reference, on a HydroCel GSN 64 1.0.

cases.name: egi_64
cases.description: E1 to E64 on a HydroCel GSN 64 1.0.

cases.name: egi_e257
cases.description: E1 to E257 on a HydroCel GSN 256 1.0: E257 is Cz on the 257 net.

cases.name: egi_e65
cases.description: E1 to E65 on a HydroCel GSN 64 1.0: E65 is Cz on the 65 net. E65 is an electrode of the 128, 129, 256 and 257 nets, which the 65 net dismisses.

cases.name: hbn_without_cap_model
cases.description: The Healthy Brain Network (HBN) releases as published: E1 to E128 and Cz on a HydroCel 128-channel net whose vertex reference is Cz, with no CapManufacturersModelName (their ManufacturersModelName names the recording system, says 128-channel GSN 200 v.2.1, and is not read). The names are numbered alike on the HydroCel nets and on older nets, on other positions, so they do not place the recording; nor is a reference reported for a refusal.

cases.name: hbn_with_cap_model
cases.description: The same channels with a corrected CapManufacturersModelName, HydroCel GSN 128 1.0, and EEGReference Cz: placed on the HydroCel 129 net, and Cz is reported as the reference channel, not dropped (a map leaves it out only when all its values are exactly zero).

cases.name: reference_by_alias
cases.description: E1 to E128 and Cz on a HydroCel GSN 128 1.0 with EEGReference VREF, EGI's name for the vertex reference: VREF is Cz on an EGI net, so Cz is the reference channel.

cases.name: reference_on_ten_twenty
cases.description: The 10-20 names referenced to Cz, which is recorded: Cz is placed and reported as the reference (EEGReference written CZ, normalized as a name).

cases.name: reference_names_no_channel
cases.description: The 10-20 names with EEGReference linked mastoids: no channel is the reference.

cases.name: reference_not_split
cases.description: The 10-20 names with A1 and A2, and EEGReference A1-A2: a reference is never split at a hyphen, so a1-a2 names no electrode, and no channel is the reference (A1 would be, were it split).

cases.name: reference_on_biosemi
cases.description: A BioSemi 64 recording named by bank (A1 to B32) with EEGReference A1, the left ear's 10-05 name and a bank label: a reference names a channel only on the 10-05 montage and the HydroCel nets, so none here.

cases.name: reference_not_recorded
cases.description: The 10-20 names without Cz, with EEGReference Cz: the reference is not among the channels.

cases.name: older_egi_net_gsn_200
cases.description: E1 to E128 and Cz on a cap named 128-channel GSN 200 v.2.1: no listed model, so refused. The older nets' montages (EEGLAB's GSN128 and GSN129) are never reached by name.

cases.name: older_egi_net_by_eeglab_file
cases.description: E1 to E256 on a cap named GSN256, EEGLAB's file name for an older 256-channel net: not a listed model, so refused.

cases.name: older_egi_net_gsn_64_v2
cases.description: E1 to E64 on a cap named Geodesic Sensor Net 64 2.0, the GSN 64 version 2.0: not a listed model, so refused.

cases.name: cap_model_case_and_whitespace
cases.description: E1 to E256 on a cap named '  hydroCEL   gsn 256 1.0 ': the model is trimmed, its whitespace collapsed and its letters folded before it is compared.

cases.name: cap_model_of_another_size
cases.description: E1 to E256 on a cap named HydroCel GSN 128 1.0: the names point to the 256-channel net, which the model does not name.

cases.name: cap_model_not_listed
cases.description: E1 to E128 and Cz on a cap named EGI HydroCel 128: models are compared against the list exactly, so a name the list does not hold is refused.

cases.name: cap_model_beside_other_names
cases.description: The 10-20 names on a cap named HydroCel GSN 128 1.0: the model is read only when the names point to a HydroCel net.

cases.name: egi_prefix_of_128
cases.description: E1 to E100 on a HydroCel GSN 128 1.0: the 128 net holds every name, but 100 is below 90% of its 128 electrodes, so the names may come from a cap this algorithm does not list.

cases.name: egi_prefix_of_64
cases.description: E1 to E40 on a HydroCel GSN 64 1.0: 40 of the 64 net's electrodes.

cases.name: egi_duplicate_on_a_partial_net
cases.description: E1 to E100 and E001 on a HydroCel GSN 128 1.0: a duplicate is reported before the coverage.

cases.name: egi_e1_to_e28
cases.description: E1 to E28 on a HydroCel GSN 32: the 32 net and the BioSemi 160 E bank both hold the names; an ambiguity is reported before the 32 net's coverage (28 of 33).

cases.name: egi_129_twelve_dropped
cases.description: E1 to E128 and Cz with twelve electrodes dropped, on a HydroCel GSN 128: 117 of 129 is at least 90% of the net.

cases.name: egi_129_thirteen_dropped
cases.description: E1 to E128 and Cz with thirteen electrodes dropped: 116 of 129 is below 90% of the net, which is reported although the cap model names the net.

cases.name: biosemi_160_at_ninety_percent
cases.description: A1 to D32 and E1 to E16: 144 of the BioSemi 160 cap's electrodes, exactly 90%.

cases.name: biosemi_160_below_ninety_percent
cases.description: A1 to D32 and E1 to E15: 143 of 160.

cases.name: egi_e33_ambiguous_with_biosemi_e_bank
cases.description: E1 to E33 on a cap named GSN-HydroCel-32: E33 is Cz on the 32 net, which matches all 33 names, but the BioSemi 160 cap's E bank matches E1 to E32 (97%) on other positions.

cases.name: egi_32_ambiguous_with_biosemi_e_bank
cases.description: E1 to E32 and Cz on a cap named GSN-HydroCel-32: the BioSemi 160 cap's E bank matches 32 of the 33 names (97%), on other positions, so the names do not identify a net.

cases.name: biosemi_16
cases.description: A BioSemi 16 cap, named by bank as a recording names it (A1 to A16).

cases.name: biosemi_32
cases.description: A BioSemi 32 cap (A1 to A32). The 128 cap's A bank holds the same names on other positions; the 32 cap, smaller, dismisses it.

cases.name: biosemi_64
cases.description: A BioSemi 64 cap (A1 to B32).

cases.name: biosemi_64_zero_padded
cases.description: A01 to B32: zero-padded bank numbers.

cases.name: biosemi_64_with_exg
cases.description: A1 to B32 and the eight external channels, all typed EEG: the external channels stay unplaced.

cases.name: biosemi_64_cms_suffix
cases.description: A1-CMS to B32-CMS: the shared suffix names BioSemi's common mode sense reference and is stripped.

cases.name: biosemi_64_at_ninety_percent
cases.description: A1 to B26: 58 of the BioSemi 64 cap's electrodes, the fewest at or above 90%.

cases.name: biosemi_64_below_ninety_percent
cases.description: A1 to B25: 57 of 64.

cases.name: biosemi_16_at_ninety_percent
cases.description: A1 to A15: 15 of the BioSemi 16 cap's electrodes, the fewest at or above 90%.

cases.name: biosemi_16_below_ninety_percent
cases.description: A1 to A14: 14 of 16.

cases.name: biosemi_128
cases.description: A BioSemi 128 cap (A1 to D32) with external and status channels left untyped. The 160 and 256 caps hold the same names; the 128 cap, of the same family and smaller, holds every name they matched.

cases.name: biosemi_160
cases.description: A BioSemi 160 cap (A1 to E32).

cases.name: biosemi_256
cases.description: A BioSemi 256 cap (A1 to H32).

cases.name: ten_five_or_biosemi
cases.description: A1, A2 and C1 to C6 are 10-05 names and BioSemi names on other positions: the two families tie.

cases.name: runner_up_at_ninety_percent
cases.description: 18 names are both 10-05 and BioSemi 256 names; with Fz and Cz the 10-05 montage matches 20 and the BioSemi 256 cap 18 (90%, a contender).

cases.name: runner_up_below_ninety_percent
cases.description: With Pz as well the 10-05 montage matches 21 and the BioSemi 256 cap 18 (86%, not a contender).
